      A deliberately small model

      3–6 empty, non-replaced boxes; horizontal-tb/ltr, row/nowrap, grow 0, explicit px basis/minimum, content-box and zero margin/padding/border/gap. No automatic minimum, intrinsic content, wrapping, percentages or full-browser simulation.
